implementation: Round 2 Pack Manager (Anshul Nautiyal). One batched Gemini call per box lists what is in the box and never sees the order; fixed rules compare that with the order. No model key means a pending record, not a guess. See agents/pack/README.md and PROVENANCE.md.
notes: Needs GEMINI_API_KEY for live checks. Box photos go in data/input/<unit_id>/pack/. Tests use scripted perceivers and need no key.
